root_idea.summary: The root centers on covering, enclosing, or overlaying something so that it is hidden or obstructed.
root_idea.development: From physical covering and concealment develop cloud cover, obscurity or perplexity, emotional distress that overwhelms the heart, and several specialized senses involving dense growth, covered surfaces, or muffled sound.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Distinct Quranic noun meaning distress or anguish.
Distinct Quranic noun in the construction describing an obscure, perplexing, or constricting affair.

senses.usage_conditions: A collective or plural noun for clouds; the covering of the sky or sunlight is part of the word's lexical association, not a restriction to a particular color or thickness.
A state of emotional trouble or oppression affecting the heart; the Quranic contexts use the noun for distress and anguish rather than for a physical covering.

senses.definition: Obscurity, perplexity, or uncertainty concerning an affair.
senses.usage_conditions: Used especially in the construction أَمْرٌ غُمَّةٌ or أَمْرُكُمْ عَلَيْكُمْ غُمَّةً for a case whose meaning, outcome, or proper course is unclear or concealed.

senses.definition: A constricting distress, difficulty, or oppressive predicament.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction concerning an affair, the word can denote the case's straitness and anxiety as well as its obscurity; this is a lexical interpretation of the construction, not a claim that every use means emotional grief.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cover, veil, conceal, or overlie something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes concealing a visible object, rising over it as a covering, and making information obscure or difficult to understand.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To grieve, distress, or make someone sorrowful.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive causative use describing the effect of an event or person on another's heart.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put a muzzle, nose-bag, or similar covering over an animal's mouth or nostrils.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized transitive use, especially of an ass, camel, or similar animal, to prevent feeding or otherwise cover the mouth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To grieve one another or cause one another sorrow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form III expressing reciprocal or mutual grief.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The sky became clouded or overcast.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form IV intransitive use said of the sky; a secondary interpretation equates it with becoming altered, while the clouded-sky meaning is the primary lexical explanation here.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause great grief or sadness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested in the expression مَا أَغَمَّكَ لِيَ; the attribution of this Form IV usage is reported with disagreement in the source.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pretend or display grief without genuinely feeling it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form VI describing an outward show of grief.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become covered, veiled, or concealed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Intransitive Form VII use said of a thing that becomes hidden or overlaid.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become grieved, sorrowful, sad, or unhappy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Intransitive Form VIII emotional use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A plant or herbage became tall, tangled, luxuriant, and abundant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form VIII use specifically said of vegetation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man withheld himself from going out or forth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Form VIII use said of a person who stays in rather than departing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To utter a deep or indistinct cry, as a frightened bull or a courageous man in combat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The source applies the vocalization to animals and to warriors raising their voices in conflict.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To speak indistinctly so that the articulation or meaning is not understood.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Speech is muffled or unclear to the listener, sometimes because something is held in the speaker's mouth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bow produced a sound.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized use said of the sound made by a bow.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An infant whimpered or cried while nursing at the breast.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized infant vocalization, especially when the milk is insufficient.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To utter cries while drowning or being pressed beneath the water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form V use describing a person overwhelmed by waves; the source gives Pharaoh as a poetic application.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An intensely hot, oppressive day that nearly takes away the breath.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An attributive expression for oppressive heat; related expressions may also describe a night or weather producing such distress.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cloud-covered or misty night in which the new moon cannot be seen.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression may also refer to the last night of the lunar month when its status is hidden or uncertain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A feminine form or epithet corresponding to غَمٌّ, grief or distress.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This vocalized form is distinct from Quranic غُمَّةٌ meaning an obscure or constricting affair.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The bottom or interior portion of a skin used for clarified butter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized material noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Obscurity, confusion, or dubiousness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A variant noun for a state of unclear or confused understanding, distinct in vocalization from غُمَّةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Hair flowing down so as to narrow or cover the forehead and back of the neck, or the condition of having such hair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A physical description of abundant hair, not a general meaning of concealment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Hailstones or hail.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional expression literally associated with the clouds.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cold or nasal rheum, coryza.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate vocalized noun from the ordinary cloud term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Small stars that are faint or indistinct.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural noun reported without a singular in the cited evidence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Fresh or green herbage growing beneath dry or withered herbage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A vegetation term based on the notion of one layer being covered by another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Milk heated until it thickens.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The covering or congealing process motivates this specialized use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Herbage or vegetation protected as the growth of a valley.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension in which vegetation is associated with the water brought by clouds.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cloth or covering used to bind a she-camel's eyes or muzzle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It may be used to stop the nose or redirect the animal toward another's young; plural غَمَائِمُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The prepuce of a boy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative comparison with a covering or binding.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Dust.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized noun or lexicalized form equated with غَبَرَةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Darkness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized noun or lexicalized form derived from the notion of covering.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Hardship, difficulty, or distress overwhelming a party in battle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use for an oppressive battle situation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A calamity or misfortune.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized lexical use reported alongside the sense of a difficult affair.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A hard or difficult affair in which the right course is not known.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes a perplexing case or predicament rather than ordinary emotional grief.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A dubious or confused affair or situation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used substantively or in the expression إِنَّهُمْ لَفِي غَمَّاءَ مِنَ الْأَمْرِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The cries of frightened bulls or of courageous men in combat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A verbal noun used as a substantive for the vocalizations themselves.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Indistinct or muffled speech whose articulation cannot be distinguished.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The listener hears the voice but cannot make out the words clearly.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The sound of bows.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized sound noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man whose hair falls so abundantly that it narrows or covers the face and back of the neck.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The feminine form غَمَّاءُ can be applied to a woman; this is a physical hair description.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A horse's forelock that is excessively abundant in hair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized feminine adjective applied to the forelock.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Dense cloud with no gap or interstice.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative adjective describing closely continuous cloud cover.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Land having abundant, dense, or luxuriant herbage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A feminine adjectival form describing fertile vegetation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Abounding in water and covering or submerging what it contains.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to clouds, a sea, a well, or a spring-like water source that fills and overwhelms its surroundings.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Covered, veiled, or concealed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The passive participle of غَمَّهُ; the following specialized uses retain the idea of something being enclosed or overlaid.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Unripe dates placed in a jar and covered until they ripen.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized passive-participial use applied to dates undergoing covered ripening.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A new moon veiled or intercepted by clouds so that it cannot be seen.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive-participial description of the moon's hidden visibility.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Grieved, sorrowful, or made unhappy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive-participial emotional use applied to a person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Affected by the ailment called غُمَامٌ, a nasal or coryzal complaint.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized medical use distinct from the ordinary passive meaning covered or concealed.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Hair flowing over the forehead and neck.
Disputed attribution of the same expression.
A reported “demersit” use is not assigned because its intended sense is unspecified.
Crying of a bull or warrior.
Warrior raising his voice in conflict.
Cloud or mist concealing the moon.
Hair covering the forehead and neck.
Figurative use for a boy's prepuce.
Covered dates ripening in a jar.

cautions: The Quranic form غُمَّة is distinct in vocalization and lexical identity from the Classical غَمَّة (feminine of غَمّ) and غِمَّة (obscurity or confusion).
A historical Quran citation occurring in Lane's cloud-cover discussion is not converted into a modern verse location because the packet does not independently identify a corresponding QAC occurrence.
The Form IV meaning associated with ما أَغَمَّكَ لِي is reported with source disagreement and is retained as a qualified Classical usage rather than treated as an uncontroversial primary sense.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: lane-unit:gmm:29829:g2:sub3 reports a “Demersit” use of أَغَمَّ but does not specify which lexical sense is intended; it is therefore left unresolved rather than assigned to clouding, covering, or grieving.
